trigger: Run only if the Stage 1 teacher-only dataset baseline is valid and has at least 5/50 successes. If it has 0-4/50, stop and diagnose; do not run four arms.

scope.sample_size: the exact 50 rows in selected_tasks.json from the single valid teacher-only retry job; record that PBS job ID in the follow-up result. The startup-failed job 25531848.pbs101 is not eligible.

task_and_protocol.row_order: Reuse the baseline selected_tasks.json array exactly; do not regenerate, reorder, filter, or select from outcomes.
task_and_protocol.data_preprocessing: Same full-dataset action/proprio/state StandardScaler fits, NaN-row exclusion, reused goal scalers, and ImageNet/Resize224 pixel/goal transforms as the teacher baseline.
task_and_protocol.world_evaluator: pinned World.evaluate dataset mode with upstream callables, goal_offset_steps=25, eval_budget=50, world.max_episode_steps=100 (effective rollout budget 50), and video=None
task_and_protocol.solver: Pinned CEMSolver; batch_size=1, num_samples=300, n_steps=30, topk=30, var_scale=1, CUDA; no solve/update-rule changes.

arm_definitions.student_only: student cost on all CEM rounds
arm_definitions.late_teacher7: teacher cost on 1-indexed rounds 24-30; student cost otherwise
arm_definitions.teacher_only: teacher cost on all CEM rounds
arm_definitions.uniform_teacher7: teacher cost on 1-indexed rounds 4,8,12,16,20,24,28; student cost otherwise

run_order.unit: one complete vectorized 50-task arm evaluation; save the actual order before loading the teacher or student

paired_solver_randomness.mechanism: Each arm constructs a fresh pinned CEMSolver from the same upstream config seed=42. Preserve native self.torch_gen stream across calls; do not reseed between solves. Matching solve ordinals use identical innovations when pre-solve generator state and candidate tensor shape match.
paired_solver_randomness.guard: Capture each solve ordinal, generator state before solve, and candidate-noise tensor shape; compare states/shapes across arms for the common solve prefix. If they diverge, fail the paired-innovation validity gate and do not claim matched innovations. No tensor hashing.
paired_solver_randomness.baseline_alignment: This seed/stream choice matches the unmodified teacher baseline's configured CEM seed and avoids introducing new solver seeds in the paired follow-up.

unit_and_inference.episode_unit: one selected dataset row, paired across all four arms
unit_and_inference.source_cluster: episode_idx; multiple selected rows from one expert episode belong to one cluster
unit_and_inference.primary_test: Two-sided exact cluster sign-flip test for late_teacher7 versus student_only: D_e is the sum across rows in source episode e of (late success - student success); independently flip each cluster sign under the null; compute exact tail probability for absolute total D using integer dynamic programming over reachable integer totals.
unit_and_inference.assumption: Source expert episodes are independent clusters and paired arm labels are exchangeable within each cluster under the sharp no-effect null. Report cluster count and row multiplicities.
unit_and_inference.mcnemar_boundary: When every selected episode_idx is unique, each cluster has one row and the sign-flip test reduces to exact two-sided McNemar. Never report a row-level McNemar p-value as the primary inference when episode IDs repeat.

validity: exactly 50 selected tasks in baseline file
all four arms use the exact same task keys/order, preprocessing, goal/callables and budget
all numeric outputs finite apart from source-defined NaN reset placeholders handled by the frozen semantic comparator
paired solver generator states and tensor shapes match for the common solve prefix
gates.late_teacher7_benefit_vs_student_only: At least 5 more successes out of 50 and exact cluster sign-flip p<0.05; otherwise this gate fails. The +5 margin is practical, and the p-value is cluster-aware.
gates.late_teacher7_practical_teacher_gap: late_teacher7 success count is at least teacher_only count minus 5/50. Descriptive engineering margin only; not formal non-inferiority.
gates.late_teacher7_planner_latency: CUDA-synchronized sum of official CEM solve walltime across the 50-task evaluation; late_teacher7 / teacher_only <= 0.70 (at least 30% lower). Report total evaluation wallclock separately.
gates.teacher_call_efficiency: Record teacher cost calls by arm and solve ordinal; late_teacher7 total calls should be no more than 30% of teacher_only calls for a complete equal-length rollout. Treat early termination differences as part of observed outcomes and report actual counts.
gates.uniform_teacher7: Same-budget secondary control; report success, paired cluster-aware contrast, calls, and planner time; not part of the primary pass gate.
gates.overall: PASS only when validity and all three late7 primary success/teacher-gap/latency gates pass. Otherwise report FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE as applicable; no extension or retry.

resources.submission: No PBS submission in this design turn. Reassess only after baseline meets its frozen engineering gate.
